description: Installation of new company branded signage (shopfront elevation) to consist of the following: one Internally illuminated (letters / symbol only), fascia sign, together with four vinyl window graphics and Red LED 'STATIC' Lighting goal post feature illuminations, affixed to the internal face of shop front glazing and re-positioning of one existing internally illuminated (letters / symbol only) projecting sign
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission
Condition : 3 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A050, A051 and A210  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
